name: svasamm-website
description: SVASAMM Business Process Automation Solutions Website

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy && npm run minify && npm run optimize
scripts.copy: cp index.html dist/ && cp -r styles dist/ && cp -r scripts dist/ && (cp -r assets dist/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.minify: npm run minify:css && npm run minify:js && npm run minify:html
scripts.minify:css: cleancss -o dist/styles/styles.min.css dist/styles/styles.css && npm run update-css-ref
scripts.minify:js: terser dist/scripts/script.js -o dist/scripts/script.min.js --compress --mangle && npm run update-js-ref
scripts.minify:html: html-minifier --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-optional-tags --remove-redundant-attributes --remove-script-type-attributes --remove-tag-whitespace --use-short-doctype --minify-css true --minify-js true -o dist/index.min.html dist/index.html && mv dist/index.min.html dist/index.html
scripts.validate: npm run validate:html && npm run validate:css
scripts.test: echo 'Running basic validation tests...' && npm run validate

author: SVASAMM
